description:
From the fz-kdt.107 step-3 review (2026-09-01): the 19-escape census
helper (drive_test.rs:~9231 blind_escapes) triggers on predicate
EQUALITY; production's covers uses overlaps_on_an_erasing_axis. At
dd97b2df2 both triggers report 19 (independently verifiable), but
under 107.3's refined axis the equality trigger reports 0 while the
honest relation reports 2 -- the instrument would blind itself
exactly when its number becomes the headline. One-line correction +
re-pin; land BEFORE 107.3 so its 19->2 is measured on a trustworthy
instrument.
title: blind_escapes must trigger on the relation production uses
